title: Host human confirmation and edit authorization
summary: Mint a Host-owned single-use apply credential only after an authenticated UI authorizer accepts an exact proposal. Recheck session, target, revision and effective edit authority before apply.

replaceability.why: The adapter and layering machinery are the Host foundation. If this machinery could be replaced by a creator layer, automatic fallback to the original could not be guaranteed. The Lucs carried by open protocols have their own replacement classes.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, self-Luc spec v0.3, 2026-10-18; interface charter rule 6, 2026-10-22

reach.notes: Trusted Host machinery, not authority granted to a Luc. Package calls remain bounded by their resolved permissions, Host APIs and editable scope.

operations.name: confirm_proposal

proposal.description: Canonical layout-adjust value plus proposal_only.emphasis in [0,1]; tool shape see iface:layout.adjust/v1.

operations.notes: No deadline. Each successful call mints a new random credential after the private authorizer returns exactly True. Credential belongs only to trusted Host/UI and never the model invoke result. Currently only the canonical layout-adjust proposal is supported.

operations.name: authorize_edit

proposal.description: Canonical layout-adjust value plus proposal_only.emphasis in [0,1]; tool shape see iface:layout.adjust/v1.

output.description: Python tuple of authorized native property names.

operations.notes: No deadline. Successful credential verification consumes it before Host API/edit-scope authorization. Reuse is invalid even if later scope authorization fails. This method authorizes fields; it does not mutate the Project.

operations.name: retire_interaction
operations.notes: No deadline. Drops all credentials bound to interaction; repeating with a valid id is natural.

invariants.text: Successful verification atomically consumes the exact actor/binding/proposal credential; invalid proof cannot consume a valid credential.
Actor session, Project, target kind/id and exact base revision must still match the confirmed binding.

break: The operation rejects invalid input, integrity, authority or binding state as described by its operation.

conformance.notes: Existing tests listed here were inspected, not run for this documentation task. The area checker validates the contract files; it does not exercise runtime behavior.

known_deviations.text: Credential verification consumes the proof before the final Host API/edit-field checks. A scope rejection requires a new confirmation before another attempt.
Canonical confirmation is hard-coded to the layout-adjust surface rather than a general adapter-owned proposal validator.
